topic: DeepSeek Harness iOS Simulator Plugin: Drive iOS Apps from Your Coding Agent

key_points: Canonical source for the DSH iOS Simulator plugin (npm @zseven-w/dsh-ios, v0.1.0-rc.3, 266 stars). Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1. Everything is a plugin built on Cordis.

22 agent tools across simulator AND real iPhone over USB: devices, boot/shutdown, screenshot, interact, build & run, unified logs, AXe-backed UI tree, tap-by-element, list/feed rows, Vision OCR find/tap, SwiftUI preview hot reload, processes, backtrace, leaks, app info.
Live MJPEG sidebar panel: signed expiring URLs served through _/_dsh/dsh-ios/*; browser never touches serve-sim's port. Tap, drag, rotate, Home directly on the video.
Real iPhone: ios_real_start_wda builds & launches WebDriverAgent on the phone, tunnels control (REST) + screen (MJPEG) ports over loopback; every real-device tap gated by identify-before-tap rules.
Semantic UI automation over guessed coordinates: ios_sim_ui_tree (AXe-backed), ios_sim_tap_element by label/identifier; Vision OCR fallback (ios_sim_find_text / tap_text) when the tree is empty.
Loopback-only transport: serve-sim binds 127.0.0.1, HMAC capabilities expire within 10 minutes. Xcode build of a Swift package/preview hot-swaps in ~2-5s without relaunch.

Troubleshooting: macOS Developer Mode (sudo DevToolsSecurity -enable), brew install cameroncooke/axe/axe for AXe, OCR helper compiles on first use, iOS 26.2 leaks quirk, free-team WDA signing lasts 7 days.
Official DeepSeek Harness developer-preview product page; HN launch 'DeepSeek Harness developer preview' hit 747 points / 314 comments.
Positioned as an open-source agent harness where 'everything is a plugin', powered by Cordis.
Signals the shift toward letting coding agents run and verify iOS apps natively inside the harness workflow.
Official repo (203K stars, TypeScript). Run with `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, Web UI on http://127.0.0.1:3080 by default; `--no-open` for headless/SSH.
'Everything is a plugin' architecture; tools, commands, skills, MCP all implemented as Cordis plugins; add dsh-plugin topic for discoverability.
Still in developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes expected; docs at deepseek-harness.github.io; npm or pnpm install + build from source.
Complete introduction to dsh ('everything is a plugin') as of 2026/08; version 0.1.0-rc.5 at the time of writing.
Explains the unified plugin mechanism: a JS/TS module exporting apply(ctx, config) can register tools, slash commands, skills, or MCP on ctx - no separate manifest format per capability.
Frames dsh as collapsing multiple extensibility systems (tools / commands / skills / MCP config) into one concept.
Curated list of DeepSeek Harness plugins (13500+ stars); the dsh-ios plugin is catalogued alongside 2000+ other dsh plugins, confirming an active ecosystem.
Shows adjacent plugins for iOS/device work and the general trajectory of dsh plugin development in 2026.

stats.fact: DeepSeek Harness is built around an 'everything-is-a-plugin' architecture on the Cordis framework and is in developer preview.
The dsh-ios Simulator plugin ships 22 agent tools, covers live iOS Simulator control AND USB-connected real iPhones via WebDriverAgent.
dsh-ios current release is v0.1.0-rc.3 (npm @zseven-w/dsh-ios), tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1; the repo had 266 stars by 2026-08-29.
DeepSeek Harness 'developer preview' HN launch reached 747 points with 314 comments.
DeepSeek Harness repo exceeded 203K GitHub stars by 2026-08-29, reflecting strong community momentum.
SwiftUI preview hot reload via ios_sim_preview regenerates a disposable host app and hot-swaps edits into the running simulator in ~2-5 seconds without relaunch.
On a real iPhone, WebDriverAgent free-team signing expires after 7 days, after which you must re-run ios_real_start_wda to rebuild.
The plugin avoids image-blocks/screen-recording files: visual bytes reach the browser only through signed, expiring HMAC routes (_/_dsh/dsh-ios/*) with capabilities valid ~10 minutes.

angles: From CLI agent to visual device: dsh-ios turns your coding agent into an iOS QA/tester that can see and drive a live simulator (even a real iPhone over USB), not just run commands.
22 built-in tools as the practical taxonomy: devices, build & run, accessibility-tree tapping, OCR, list/feed row automation, SwiftUI preview hot reload, logs, backtraces, processes, leaks.
Identity-based UI automation vs coordinate guessing: AXe/WebDriverAgent accessibility tree + tap-by-element + Vision OCR fallback is the reliable way an LLM can interact with native UI.
Real iPhone over USB with WebDriverAgent - physical-device testing from a coding agent, with coded failure reasons (device-locked, cert-untrusted, profile-expired, tunnel-failed, device-unplugged).
Safety-first design: loopback-only transport, signed expiring URLs, identify-before-tap rules for real devices - secure by construction rather than bolted on.
Practical getting-started path for developers: npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web, then install the dsh-ios plugin, list devices, boot an iPhone 17 Pro simulator, build & run, drive the UI, preview hot reload.
Positioning: DeepSeek Harness (200K+ stars) plugin ecosystem is maturing fast; dsh-ios is the reference mobile-workflow plugin in that ecosystem.
